groups.label: Purple blooms
groups.blurb: The purple mass that carries the storefront — clustered main flowers with fine misty fillers.

items.role: Large purple clusters massed along the facade — the visual main flower.
Tall purple line flowers pulling the vertical layers upward.
Fine purple filler clusters scattered between the main blooms.
Misty purple strands softening the transitions.
Soft layered lilac blooms easing the purple into the yellow zones.

groups.label: Yellow accents
groups.blurb: Golden touches scattered through the purple mass for the wild, sunny contrast.

items.role: Yellow line flowers paired with the purple spikes for height.
Light single-petal yellow poppies dotted through the greenery.
Fine fresh yellow daisies scattered across the facade.

groups.label: Pink touches
groups.blurb: Small soft accents keeping the purple-and-yellow mix from going hard.

items.role: A few soft pink ranunculus tucked in as gentle accents.

groups.label: Base greens & trailing vines
groups.blurb: The large wild green base covering the facade, with fine vines trailing naturally off the frame.

items.role: Fluffy massed needle leaves filling the base layer.
Mixed eucalyptus varieties adding grey-toned depth through the greens.
Light misty grass strands adding airy movement.
Misty filler weaving through the flower mass.
Fine winding vine strands threading through and trailing off the frame.
Berry-bearing fine branches threading upward through the greens.
